sentences.en: Others express devastation or relief over a breakup.

sentences.en: Jason's story began in May 2015.

sentences.en: He had just started a new, more demanding project at work that had him putting in upwards of 60 hours a week.
sentences.zh: 他刚在工作中接手了一个要求更高的新项目，这让他每周的工作时间高达60多小时。

sentences.en: During this stressful time, Jason noticed that his 29-year-old wife had added a password to her mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 在这个压力重重的时期，杰森注意到他29岁的妻子给手机加了密码。

sentences.en: He questioned her about it, and she explained she was planning a Father's Day present for him and didn't want to ruin the surprise.
sentences.zh: 他质问她，她解释说她正在为他筹备父亲节礼物，不想破坏惊喜。

sentences.en: About a week later, Jason's wife said she was feeling guilty for keeping a secret from him
sentences.zh: 大约一周后，杰森的妻子说，因为对他隐瞒感到内疚，

sentences.zh: 她透露自己雇用了他们的邻居——一名51岁的承包商，来为杰森建造一间家庭办公室。

sentences.en: It struck Jason as odd that his wife felt guilty, as they'd been together for six years and she'd never once said she felt guilty about anything
sentences.zh: 杰森觉得妻子感到内疚很奇怪，因为他们已经在一起六年了，而她从来没有对任何事情表示过内疚。

sentences.en: As time went on, things didn't feel right.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，事情感觉不对劲了。

sentences.en: Jason's wife began using her password-protected phone more often, sometimes smiling to herself while doing so.
sentences.zh: 杰森的妻子开始更频繁地使用她那加密的手机，有时一边操作一边自己暗笑。

sentences.en: When Jason asked what she was doing, she'd respond, nothing, then quickly put her phone away.
sentences.zh: 当杰森问她在做什么时，她回答说“没什么”，然后迅速把手机收了起来。

sentences.en: One morning after Jason's wife got in the shower, he managed to grab her phone before it auto-locked and required the password to access.

sentences.zh: 他们之间没有其他信息，杰森后来得知这是因为他的妻子将手机设置成了在一段时间后自动删除信息。

sentences.en: While the text made Jason uncomfortable, he was aware that his wife had a, quote, perverted sense of humour and was convinced she wouldn't actually do anything to hurt him.
sentences.zh: 虽然这条短信让杰森感到不舒服，但他知道妻子有一种用他话说“变态的幽默感”，并且坚信她实际上不会做什么来伤害他。

sentences.en: Their neighbour began spending more and more time at Jason's house, but the construction of the home office was taking longer and longer.
sentences.zh: 他们的邻居开始在杰森家花越来越多的时间，但家庭办公室的建设却拖延得越来越久。

sentences.en: Unable to shake his paranoia, Jason began checking his wife's location via her mobile phone's inbuilt
sentences.zh: 无法摆脱内心的多疑，杰森开始通过手机内置的

sentences.en: GPS that, when active, kept a detailed record of every place the device had gone.
sentences.zh: GPS来查看妻子的位置。该功能在激活时会详细记录设备去过的每一个地方。

sentences.en: He noticed there were large gaps in her GPS history because she kept turning off the function.
sentences.zh: 他注意到她的GPS历史记录中有很大的空白期，因为她一直在关闭该功能。

sentences.en: In July, Jason gained access to his wife's phone under the pretense that he needed to download antivirus software onto it.
sentences.zh: 7月，杰森以需要在手机上下载杀毒软件为借口，获得了使用妻子手机的权限。

sentences.en: Instead, he downloaded anti-theft software, which allowed him to remotely turn on the phone's GPS while also reading all it sent and received text messages from his computer.
sentences.zh: 相反，他下载了防盗软件，这让他可以通过电脑远程开启手机的GPS，同时阅读手机发送和接收的所有短信。

sentences.en: The next day, Jason monitored his wife's phone from his computer at work.
sentences.zh: 第二天，杰森在公司的电脑上监控着妻子的手机。

sentences.en: She messaged their neighbour asking to meet up, but he couldn't as he was busy at another job site.
sentences.zh: 她给邻居发信息要求见面，但他因为在另一个工地上忙而无法赴约。

sentences.en: That night, Jason, his wife and their two children went out for dinner with the neighbour, his girlfriend and his son.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，杰森、他的妻子和他们的两个孩子与邻居、邻居的女友以及他的儿子一起出去吃晚饭。

sentences.en: The two women had a good time drinking, laughing and joking around.
sentences.zh: 两个女人喝酒、大笑、开玩笑，玩得很开心。

sentences.en: After dinner, Jason offered to look after the kids so that the two women could go see a movie together.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后，杰森主动提出照顾孩子，以便两个女人可以一起去看电影。

sentences.en: They headed off while Jason, his neighbour and their children went back to Jason's house.
sentences.zh: 她们出发了，而杰森、他们的邻居和孩子们则回到了杰森家。

sentences.en: The kids gathered around to play video games as Jason and his neighbour sat on adjacent couches.
sentences.zh: 孩子们聚在一起玩电子游戏，杰森和邻居坐在相邻的沙发上。

sentences.en: Jason inconspicuously kept an eye on his wife's mobile phone activity

sentences.zh: 她开始给邻居发短信，讲述她想和他进行的性行为。

sentences.en: They continued to message back and forth, trying to figure out when they could meet up to have sex
sentences.zh: 他们继续发信息，商量什么时候可以见面做爱。

sentences.en: They settled on Monday morning, after Jason went to work
sentences.zh: 他们把时间定在周一早上，杰森去上班之后。

sentences.en: Jason was barely able to keep his composure as he spied on their interactions in real time while his neighbour sat across from him none the wiser.
sentences.zh: 当邻居坐在他斜对面一无所知时，杰森实时窥探着他们的互动，几乎无法保持镇定。

sentences.en: When the pair texted that they loved each other,

sentences.en: You're my girl now, his neighbour texted his wife.

sentences.zh: “永远都是。”当两个女人看完电影回来时，杰森礼貌地请她们坐下，

sentences.en: He then sent the children into his son's room and shut the door
sentences.zh: 然后他把孩子们打发到他儿子的房间并关上了门。

sentences.en: So you two love each other, huh?
sentences.zh: “所以你们两个相爱了，是吗？”

sentences.en: he asked

sentences.zh: 他的妻子进入了杰森所说的全面否认模式。

sentences.en: Jason's wife denied that she had been texting their neighbour
sentences.zh: 杰森的妻子否认她曾给他们的邻居发过短信。

sentences.en: When Jason showed her the text messages from that night she buckled, admitting that she did send them but it was the first time their interactions had gone that far
sentences.zh: 当杰森向她展示当晚的短信时，她崩溃了，承认她的确发过，但那是他们的互动第一次发展到那种地步。

sentences.en: Jason then asked his wife if she had sent the man pictures

sentences.zh: 这一次，他的妻子再次改口并承担了责任。

sentences.zh: 尽管坚称那是她发过的第一张照片。

sentences.en: Jason outright asked his wife if she was having sex with the neighbour
sentences.zh: 杰森直截了当地问妻子她是否与邻居发生过性关系。

sentences.en: She said no, and Jason couldn't prove otherwise
sentences.zh: 她说没有，而杰森无法证明事实并非如此。

sentences.en: To Jason's surprise, his neighbour's girlfriend appeared more forgiving, saying that the fling couldn't have been serious if their partners hadn't had sex.
sentences.zh: 令杰森吃惊的是，邻居的女友显得更加宽容，她说如果他们的伴侣没有发生性关系，这段露水情缘就不算严重。

sentences.en: She went on to say that Jason and his wife were too perfect together to let the affair break them up.
sentences.zh: 她接着说，杰森和他的妻子是如此完美的一对，不应让这场外遇毁了他们的感情。

sentences.zh: 杰森告诉妻子他要离开她，这促使妻子威胁说他将再也见不到他们的孩子。

sentences.en: Jason wrote on Reddit,
sentences.zh: 杰森在红迪网上写道：

sentences.en: She planned on using the fact that I had attempted suicide in high school to prove me unfit to have the children.
sentences.zh: “她打算利用我高中时曾企图自杀这一事实，来证明我不适合抚养孩子。”

sentences.en: His wife then blamed him for her infidelity, saying it was his fault for being so busy and stressed out with work.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子随后将她不忠的原因归咎于他，说都是因为他工作太忙、压力太大。

sentences.en: She had just wanted someone she could talk to.
sentences.zh: 她只是想要一个可以倾诉的人。

sentences.zh: 接着她给杰森下了最后通牒，要么决定接下来怎么做，要么由她来做决定。

sentences.zh: 这对夫妻争吵了一夜，最终分房睡，问题没有得到任何解决。

sentences.en: Jason was going to stay at the family home while his wife took their kids to her mother's place.
sentences.zh: 杰森将留在家里，而他的妻子则带着他们的孩子去了她母亲家。

sentences.en: That Monday, Jason was in a work meeting when he received a text from his wife saying she had explained the situation to their kids.
sentences.zh: 那天星期一，杰森正在开工作会议，突然收到妻子发来的短信，说她已经向孩子们解释了情况。

sentences.en: They were upset and she wanted Jason to talk to them.
sentences.zh: 他们很难过，她希望杰森能跟他们谈谈。

sentences.en: When he returned home, both of the children were crying.
sentences.zh: 当他回到家时，两个孩子都在哭。

sentences.en: His wife had told them that mummy had to move out because dad was mad at her.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子告诉他们，妈妈不得不搬走是因为爸爸生她的气。

sentences.en: Their son wanted to live with Jason, but Jason's wife said that he couldn't.
sentences.zh: 他们的儿子想和杰森一起住，但杰森的妻子说不可以。

sentences.en: The boy had interpreted this to mean that Jason must have been mad at him too.
sentences.zh: 男孩把这理解为杰森肯定也生他的气了。

sentences.en: Jason realised that his wife was going to, quote, drag the kids through hell if he left.
sentences.zh: 杰森意识到如果他离开，他的妻子将会“带着孩子们经历人间炼狱”。

sentences.en: Instead, he bottled up his feelings and begged her to stay.
sentences.zh: 相反，他压抑住自己的情感，恳求她留下来。

sentences.en: She agreed, but insisted that he apologise to their neighbour for the sake of their sons, who were good friends
sentences.zh: 她答应了，但坚持要他为了关系很好的儿子们的缘故，向他们的邻居道歉。

sentences.en: Although Jason hated the idea, he did it anyway, as they would inevitably continue to cross paths
sentences.zh: 尽管杰森讨厌这个主意，但他还是照做了，因为他们的生活不可避免地还会有交集。

sentences.en: He would do anything for his kids, even acting civil in such distressing and emotionally crippling circumstances
sentences.zh: 为了孩子他什么都愿意做，甚至在这种令人痛苦和情感崩溃的情况下表现得彬彬有礼。

sentences.en: After this, things seemingly settled down, but Jason was constantly plagued by thoughts of his wife's infidelity.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，事情似乎平息了，但杰森时刻被妻子不忠的念头所折磨。

sentences.en: I worry, how can I keep from making her so unhappy that she cheats on me again, he wrote on Reddit.
sentences.zh: “我担心，我该如何避免让她如此不开心以至于她再次背叛我，”他在红迪网上写道。

sentences.en: Then, a year after the original incident, Jason discovered that his wife had sent the neighbour lewd photos of herself again.
sentences.zh: 接着，在最初的事件发生一年后，杰森发现妻子再次给邻居发送了自己的淫秽照片。

sentences.en: She claimed it was an accident and that she had intended to send them to Jason
sentences.zh: 她声称这是一次意外，她本来是打算发给杰森的。

sentences.zh: 尽管他不相信，但他还是放下了这件事。

sentences.zh: 杰森在红迪网帖子的末尾写道，这方面的事情已经平静了大约四个月，但他脑海里始终挥之不去。

sentences.en: This is going to sound stupid, he wrote But I feel like I have a part of my brain that can't shut off, that is always thinking
sentences.zh: “这听起来可能很蠢，”他写道，“但我觉得我大脑的一部分无法关闭，一直在思考。”

sentences.en: I used to use that to solve programming problems and it made me very good at my job.
sentences.zh: “我过去常用它来解决编程问题，这让我工作非常出色。”

sentences.en: But ever since this incident, the only thing it thinks about is her and him and if I did the right thing.
sentences.zh: “但自从发生这件事以来，它唯一想的就是她和他，以及我做得对不对。”

sentences.en: My job performance has suffered and I feel like I haven't gotten sleep in months.
sentences.zh: “我的工作表现受到了影响，我觉得自己已经几个月没睡过觉了。”

sentences.en: I'm afraid that after this much time and the fact that I begged her back, that to say that I want a divorce now would only make her more vindictive towards my children and I.
sentences.zh: “我担心经过这么长时间，再加上我是求她回来的，现在说我想离婚只会让她对我和孩子们的报复心更强。”

sentences.en: I just feel like I have to put myself so deep in a hole that I can never get back out.
sentences.zh: “我只是觉得自己好像把自己深深地埋进了一个永远爬不出来的洞里。”

sentences.en: I haven't really talked to anyone about this.
sentences.zh: “我其实没有跟任何人谈过这件事。”

sentences.en: I tried talking to one friend about it, but his advice was to put my trust in
sentences.zh: “我曾试图和一个朋友谈起此事，但他的建议是把信任寄托在

sentences.en: God.
sentences.zh: 上帝身上。”

sentences.en: That was not much solace for me as I am an atheiSt. So I have no clue what to do with my feelings or how to move on from this.
sentences.zh: “这对我来说没什么安慰，因为我是个无神论者。所以我完全不知道该怎么处理自己的情绪，也不知道该如何从这件事中走出来。”

sentences.en: Jason in Hell's post to the Relationship Advice subreddit received over 200 comments from users all around the world offering their input and support.
sentences.zh: “地狱杰森”在情感建议版块发布的帖子收到了来自世界各地用户的200多条评论，他们纷纷献计献策并给予支持。

sentences.en: The top comment had upwards of 500 upvotes, signifying that a large number of users had rated it positively.
sentences.zh: 置顶评论获得了多达500多个赞，表明有大量用户给予了正面评价。

sentences.en: Written by someone with the username Monsieur LeDude, it advised Jason in Hell not to navigate the situation alone and to seek legal counsel as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 这条评论由一个用户名为Monsieur LeDude的人撰写，他建议“地狱杰森”不要独自应付这种局面，并应尽快寻求法律顾问的帮助。

sentences.en: You won't be doing your children any favours by remaining in a marriage that is now founded on lies, infidelity and outright bullying, the user wrote.
sentences.zh: “继续维持一段建立在谎言、不忠和公然欺凌之上的婚姻，对你的孩子没有任何好处，”这位用户写道。

sentences.en: Other commenters agreed that Jason in Hell should obtain a lawyer and divorce his wife.
sentences.zh: 其他评论者也认为“地狱杰森”应该请个律师并与妻子离婚。

sentences.en: Many were outraged at his willingness to placate her by apologising to the man she had an affair with and begging her to stay
sentences.zh: 许多人对他的顺从态度感到愤怒，他竟然向出轨的那个男人道歉并恳求她留下来。

sentences.en: Smack the shit out of that man, one user demanded
sentences.zh: “狠狠地抽那个混蛋一巴掌，”一个用户要求道。

sentences.en: Others were angry that Jason's wife was blackmailing him by threatening to use his suicide attempt 15 years prior to get full custody of their children
sentences.zh: 其他人则对杰森的妻子进行勒索感到愤怒，她威胁要利用他15年前自杀未遂的经历来争夺孩子的抚养权。

sentences.en: One user called her tactics, quote,
sentences.zh: 一个用户称她的伎俩，引用原话来说，

sentences.en: Advice was also given on how Jason should navigate the legal system should he wind up having to fight for the custody of his children.
sentences.zh: 关于如果杰森最终不得不争取孩子的抚养权时，他应该如何应对法律体系，人们也给出了建议。

sentences.en: The user, 2012MustangGT, wrote,
sentences.zh: 用户2012MustangGT写道：

sentences.en: This dude's kids will someday understand the sacrifices he is making in his own life to keep them ignorantly happy.
sentences.zh: “这家伙的孩子们有一天会理解他为了让他们在无知中快乐而在自己的生活中做出的牺牲。”

sentences.en: User PorkBellyDiet wrote to Jason,
sentences.zh: 用户PorkBellyDiet给杰森写道：

sentences.en: Please know your worth, and best of luck to you and your children.
sentences.zh: “请认清你自己的价值，祝你和孩子们好运。”

sentences.en: Almost a week after his initial post, Jason in Hell reappeared on the subreddit.
sentences.zh: 在初次发帖大约一周后，“地狱杰森”再次出现在该版块。

sentences.en: In a brief update titled, I'm Taking Your Advice,
sentences.zh: 在一篇题为《我听从你们的建议》的简短更新中，

sentences.en: Jason revealed that his wife didn't want to attempt to fix their relationship and refused to undergo counselling.
sentences.zh: 杰森透露他的妻子并不想尝试修复他们的关系，并拒绝接受心理咨询。

sentences.en: He wrote,
sentences.zh: 他写道：

sentences.en: I am going to get myself and my kids out.
sentences.zh: “我要带我和孩子们离开。”

sentences.en: I meet with an attorney next week.
sentences.zh: “我下周见律师。”

sentences.en: Thank you everyone for helping me see how far I had my head up my arse.
sentences.zh: “谢谢大家帮我意识到我脑子里进水有多严重。”

sentences.en: Jason's update received only 20 comments, all of which were overwhelmingly positive.
sentences.zh: 杰森的更新只收到了20条评论，全部都是压倒性的正面评价。

sentences.en: Users reassured him that he was doing the right thing.
sentences.zh: 用户们向他保证，他正在做正确的事。

sentences.en: Monsieur Le Doute, who had encouraged Jason to seek legal counsel in the initial post,
sentences.zh: 最初曾鼓励杰森寻求法律咨询的Monsieur Le Doute，

sentences.en: Good for you and good luck.
sentences.zh: 祝你好运，也保重。

sentences.en: Remember that life on the other side of all this will be far better for both yourself and your children, and let that hope keep you going when things get rough.
sentences.zh: 记住，这一切过去之后，你和孩子们的另一端生活将会好得多，当事情变得艰难时，让这种希望支撑着你继续前行。

sentences.en: Jason and Brandy Worley were engaged for two years before tying the knot in 2009.
sentences.zh: 杰森和布兰迪·沃利订婚两年后，于2009年结为连理。

sentences.en: Their first child, a son named Tyler, was born that same year.
sentences.zh: 他们的第一个孩子，一个名叫泰勒的男孩，在同年出生。

sentences.en: Then in 2013, the couple welcomed their second child, a daughter they named Charlie.
sentences.zh: 接着在2013年，这对夫妇迎来了他们的第二个孩子，一个名叫查理的女孩。

sentences.en: Both Jason and Brandy agreed that they would always put their children first above all else, including their marriage.
sentences.zh: 杰森和布兰迪都同意，他们将永远把孩子放在首位，凌驾于一切之上，包括他们的婚姻。

sentences.en: The family of four lived in the small midwestern town of Darlington, Indiana.
sentences.zh: 这四口之家住在印第安纳州达灵顿的中西部小镇。

sentences.en: With a population of less than a thousand residents, most knew the Walleys and considered them good people.
sentences.zh: 这里人口不足千人，大多数人都认识沃利一家，并认为他们是好人。

sentences.en: Wednesday, November 16, 2016 was a typical day for the family.
sentences.zh: 2016年11月16日，星期三，对这个家庭来说是很平常的一天。

sentences.en: Jason went to his job as a software engineer, while Brandy took 7-year-old Tyler and 3-year-old Charlie to spend their day with their grandmother.
sentences.zh: 杰森去上班当软件工程师，而布兰迪则带着7岁的泰勒和3岁的查理去外祖母家过日。

sentences.en: That evening, they all attended one of Charlie's dance performances before returning home for dinner.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他们一起观看了一场查理的舞蹈表演，然后回家吃晚饭。

sentences.en: Brandy then ducked out to Walmart to buy some pipe cleaners for a project Tyler was working on for school.
sentences.zh: 随后布兰迪溜出去沃尔玛，为泰勒学校的一个项目买一些管道通条。

sentences.en: When she returned home, she joined Jason in playing with their children in the living room
sentences.zh: 她回到家后，和杰森一起在客厅里陪孩子们玩耍

sentences.en: Jason then bathed and put both Tyler and Charlie to bed before retiring for the night
sentences.zh: 接着杰森给泰勒和查理洗了澡并哄他们上床睡觉，然后自己也回房休息了

sentences.en: As it neared 5am, Jason woke to the sound of screaming
sentences.zh: 临近凌晨5点时，杰森被尖叫声惊醒

sentences.en: He rushed upstairs to find his mother-in-law crying hysterically in the kitchen
sentences.zh: 他冲上楼去，发现岳母正在厨房里歇斯底里地哭泣

sentences.en: Brandy was sitting in the nearby living room
sentences.zh: 布兰迪正坐在附近的客厅里

sentences.en: Bleeding profusely from a wound in her neck
sentences.zh: 脖子上的伤口血流如注

sentences.en: Now you can't take my children from me She told Jason
sentences.zh: “现在你不能从我身边带走我的孩子了，”她对杰森说

sentences.en: Minutes earlier, at 4.35am
sentences.zh: 几分钟前，即凌晨4点35分

sentences.en: A phone call was placed to 911
sentences.zh: 有人拨打了911

sentences.en: The dispatcher was left speechless by what he heard And was convinced the caller must have been delusional and lying
sentences.zh: 调度员被他所听到的话惊得说不出话来，并确信打电话的人一定是有妄想症而且在撒谎

sentences.en: Arlington?
sentences.zh: 达灵顿？

sentences.en: Hey, what's going on there?
sentences.zh: 嘿，那里发生什么事了？

sentences.en: I just stabbed myself and I killed my two children.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚刺伤了自己，我还杀了我两个孩子。

sentences.en: You stabbed yourself and killed your two children?
sentences.zh: 你刺伤了自己，还杀了你的两个孩子？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Randy Orley, father's mom on the floor.
sentences.zh: 兰迪·奥利，父亲的母亲在地板上。

sentences.en: My husband wanted to divorce and went and picked my kids.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫想要离婚，还去接走了我的孩子。

sentences.en: I won't want him to find my kids.
sentences.zh: 我不想让他找到我的孩子。

sentences.en: Okay, and how old are your children?
sentences.zh: 好的，你的孩子多大？

sentences.en: Four and three.
sentences.zh: 四岁和三岁。

sentences.en: Seven.

sentences.zh: 七岁？

sentences.zh: 在隔壁客厅里。

sentences.zh: 不，在我的孩子们房间里的某个地方。

sentences.en: When police arrived at the Worley house, they found Tyler and Charlie deceased in Charlie's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 当警察赶到沃利家时，他们发现泰勒和查理已经死在查理的卧室里。

sentences.en: Brandy Worley was sitting on a couch in the living room.
sentences.zh: 布兰迪·沃利正坐在客厅的沙发上。

sentences.en: She was rushed to hospital, where she remained for over a week, during which her neck wound was successfully treated.
sentences.zh: 她被紧急送往医院，并在那里呆了一周多，在此期间她的颈部伤口得到了成功治疗。

sentences.en: When police were finally able to speak to Brandy, it was the first time the lifelong Darlington resident had come to the attention of authorities
sentences.zh: 当警方终于能够与布兰迪交谈时，这是这位一生都在达灵顿生活的居民第一次引起当局的注意

sentences.en: She had no prior criminal history and there was no evidence that her children were in any danger prior to November 17
sentences.zh: 她没有犯罪前科，也没有证据表明她的孩子在11月17日之前处于任何危险之中

sentences.en: To the contrary, the Worley family was widely described as happy and loving
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，沃利一家被广泛描述为幸福而充满爱意的家庭

sentences.en: Yet, Brandy told investigators that after seven years together on Wednesday November 16, Jason had filed for divorce
sentences.zh: 然而，布兰迪告诉调查人员，在两人在一起七年后的11月16日星期三，杰森提出了离婚

sentences.en: Citing irretrievable breakdown of their marriage following Brandy's infidelity a year prior, he was no longer able to stay together for the sake of their children
sentences.zh: 由于一年前布兰迪的不忠导致他们的婚姻彻底破裂，他再也无法为了孩子们的缘故继续维持这段婚姻

sentences.en: As part of the divorce agreement, he had requested custody and child support benefits with equitable division of the family assets
sentences.zh: 作为离婚协议的一部分，他要求获得抚养权和子女抚养费，并公平分割家庭资产

sentences.en: That evening, instead of buying pipe cleaners from Walmart
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，布兰迪没有去沃尔玛买管道通条

sentences.en: Brandy purchased a K-bar style combat knife which she hid in her son's room
sentences.zh: 而是买了一把K-bar风格的战斗刀，并把它藏在儿子的房间里

sentences.en: Once everyone was in bed, she consumed large quantities of the antihistamine Benadryl in order to make herself drowsy
sentences.zh: 等所有人都上床睡觉后，她服用了大量的抗组胺药苯海拉明，好让自己昏昏欲睡

sentences.en: She then entered Tyler's bedroom and stirred him awake, saying they were going to have a sleepover in his little sister's room
sentences.zh: 接着她走进泰勒的卧室，把他摇醒，说他们要在他小妹妹的房间里搞个睡衣派对

sentences.en: She retrieved the combat knife and followed Tyler out
sentences.zh: 她拿出了那把战斗刀，跟着泰勒走了出来

sentences.en: Once inside Charlie's bedroom, Brandy straddled her son and began stabbing him in the neck
sentences.zh: 一旦进入查理的卧室，布兰迪便骑在儿子身上，开始朝他的脖子刺去

sentences.en: Charlie woke up to the commotion and asked her mother what she was doing
sentences.zh: 查理被骚动惊醒，问母亲在做什么

sentences.en: Through the darkness, Brandy responded, nothing go back to sleep.
sentences.zh: 借着黑暗，布兰迪回答道，没什么，回去睡觉吧。

sentences.en: Brandy then approached Charlie and stabbed her in the neck multiple times before inserting the knife into her own neck.
sentences.zh: 随后布兰迪走向查理，朝她的脖子连捅数刀，然后将刀刺向她自己的脖子。

sentences.en: Leaving the knife in her daughter's room, a bleeding Brandy then made her way to the living room where she picked up the phone and called her mother to tell her what she'd done.
sentences.zh: 满身是血的布兰迪把刀留在了女儿的房间里，径直走到客厅，拿起电话打给母亲，告诉她自己做了什么。

sentences.en: Brandy's mother ordered her to call 911.
sentences.zh: 布兰迪的母亲命令她报警911。

sentences.en: Brandy did as she was told, and was still speaking with the 911 dispatcher when her mother arrived and entered Charlie's room to find the two children deceased.
sentences.zh: 布兰迪照做了，当她的母亲赶到并走进查理的房间发现两个孩子已经死亡时，她仍在与911调度员通话。

sentences.en: It was her scream that woke up Jason Worley, who had been sleeping soundly in the basement.
sentences.zh: 正是她的尖叫声惊醒了此前一直在地下室熟睡的杰森·沃利。

sentences.en: Brandy told the police that she had intended to kill herself but had somehow, quote, screwed that up.
sentences.zh: 布兰迪告诉警察，她本来是想自杀的，但不知怎么的，“搞砸了”。

sentences.en: Matter of factly, she explained that she didn't want her divorcing husband to take their kids from her, so she stabbed them.
sentences.zh: 她平静地解释说，她不想让要离婚的丈夫把孩子从她身边带走，所以她捅死了他们。

sentences.en: I just wanted to die with them, she revealed.
sentences.zh: “我只是想和他们一起死，”她透露道。

sentences.en: I didn't want them to live without me.
sentences.zh: “我不想让他们没有我而活下去。”

sentences.en: The outpouring of grief from the local community was immense.
sentences.zh: 当地社区涌现出无比巨大的悲痛之情。

sentences.en: Counselors were called in to speak to devastated students at Tyler's Elementary School while neighbours of the Walleys were left in disbelief.
sentences.zh: 学校请来心理辅导员去安慰泰勒小学的崩溃学生，而沃利一家的邻居们则感到难以置信。

sentences.en: They couldn't fathom that such a horrific crime could happen to a seemingly normal family, one that often hosted get-togethers and bonfires on holidays.
sentences.zh: 他们无法想象这样可怕的罪行会发生在一个看似正常的家庭身上，这个家庭经常在节假日举办聚会和篝火晚会。

sentences.en: Brandy appeared to be a doting mother.
sentences.zh: 布兰迪看起来是一位慈爱的母亲。

sentences.en: She was often seen walking her two children around the neighbourhood and photos of them featured throughout her personal Facebook
sentences.zh: 人们经常看到她带着两个孩子在社区里散步，她的个人Facebook上到处都是他们的照片

sentences.en: page, on which she wrote, In the end, I am the only one that can give my children a happy mother that loves life.
sentences.zh: 网页上她写道：“到头来，我是唯一能给我的孩子们一个热爱生活的快乐母亲的人。”

sentences.en: Some who knew Brandy regarded her as a great person.
sentences.zh: 一些认识布兰迪的人认为她是个好人。

sentences.en: They couldn't comprehend a side of her that would compel her to kill her own children.
sentences.zh: 他们无法理解她身上竟然会有那种迫使她杀死自己亲生孩子的阴暗面。

sentences.en: An online fundraiser was launched to support Jason Worley and help pay for his children's funeral.
sentences.zh: 为了支持杰森·沃利并帮助支付他孩子们的葬礼费用，人们发起了一场在线募捐活动。

sentences.en: Tyler and Charlie were laid to rest under a shared tombstone that read, rest well, sweet babies.
sentences.zh: 泰勒和查理安息在一个共同的墓碑下，上面写着：“好好安息吧，可爱的宝贝们。”

sentences.en: Dad loves you.
sentences.zh: “爸爸爱你们。”

sentences.en: Etched next to Tyler's name was a Rowlet, an owl-like creature from the series Pokemon.
sentences.zh: 在泰勒的名字旁边刻着一只木木枭，那是宝可梦系列中的一种猫头鹰般的生物。

sentences.en: Charlie's name was accompanied by the snowman
sentences.zh: 查理的名字旁则伴随着雪人

sentences.en: Olaf from the Disney film Frozen.
sentences.zh: 奥拉夫，出自迪士尼电影《冰雪奇缘》。

sentences.en: Despite a cleaning crew having since been through the
sentences.zh: 尽管清洁队后来已经打扫过了

sentences.zh: 沃利的家，但杰森发现女儿的房间里仍然弥漫着血腥味。

sentences.en: Unable to stay there any longer, he gathered some of his possessions and threw them into the back of a van.
sentences.zh: 他再也无法在那里待下去，于是收拾了一些随身物品，把它们扔进了一辆面包车的后备箱。

sentences.en: For the murders of her two children, Brandy Worley initially entered a not guilty plea with the intention of claiming the insanity defence.
sentences.zh: 关于谋杀两个孩子的罪行，布兰迪·沃利最初做出了无罪抗辩，意图以精神错乱作为辩护理由。

sentences.en: However, she ultimately accepted a plea deal and altered her plea to guilty to avoid facing a trial.
sentences.zh: 然而，她最终接受了一项认罪协议，并将抗辩改为有罪，以避免接受审判。

sentences.en: Brandy's defence attorney claimed there was no definitive reason why the murders took place.
sentences.zh: 布兰迪的辩护律师声称，谋杀发生的原因并没有确切的说法。

sentences.en: As others had described, Brandy was a wonderful, caring mother, but her lawyer said she simply snapped.
sentences.zh: 正如其他人所描述的那样，布兰迪是一位优秀、慈爱的母亲，但她的律师说她只是精神崩溃了。

sentences.en: He wanted to give the court an explanation, but conceded, I can't do that.
sentences.zh: 他想给法庭一个解释，但承认道：“我做不到。”

sentences.en: He said that Brandy had been emotional during their first few meetings, but as time wore on, she became more stoic, as that's the only way she can deal with it at this point.
sentences.zh: 他说布兰迪在他们的前几次会面中情绪激动，但随着时间推移，她变得更加坚忍，因为那是她目前唯一能应对的方式。

sentences.en: Her lawyer also revealed that since the murders, Brandy had been diagnosed with depression.
sentences.zh: 她的律师还透露，自谋杀案发生以来，布兰迪已被诊断出患有抑郁症。

sentences.en: In 2018, Jason Worley took the stand during Brandy's sentencing hearing, telling the court that his children were his life.
sentences.zh: 2018年，杰森·沃利在布兰迪的量刑听证会上出庭作证，告诉法庭他的孩子就是他的生命。

sentences.en: He described seven-year-old Tyler as a loving, energetic first grader who loved sports, the type of child who could walk into a room of strangers and walk out with 20 new friends.
sentences.zh: 他将7岁的泰勒描述为一个充满爱心、精力充沛的一年级学生，热爱运动，那种走进满是陌生人的房间出来时能交到20个新朋友的孩子。

sentences.en: He wanted to work on computers one day like his dad.
sentences.zh: 他希望有一天能像他爸爸一样从事电脑工作。

sentences.en: Three-year-old Charlie was a big ball of attitude who loved getting dressed up and wouldn't leave the house without braids or a bow in her hair.
sentences.zh: 3岁的查理则是一个个性十足的小淘气，喜欢精心打扮，如果不梳辫子或头上不戴蝴蝶结就不肯出门。

sentences.en: Jason's divorce to
sentences.zh: 杰森与

sentences.en: Brandy had been finalised in March 2017, and they hadn't spoken since the night of the murders.
sentences.zh: 布兰迪的离婚已于2017年3月最终敲定，自谋杀案当晚以来他们就再也没有说过话。

sentences.en: In regards to his ex-wife's guilty plea, Jason said,
sentences.zh: 关于他前妻的认罪，杰森说：

sentences.en: She appeared to be just as unremorseful as she did in the 911 call.
sentences.zh: 她表现得和在911电话里一样毫无悔意。

sentences.en: When asked what sentence he would like to see Brandy receive, Jason responded,
sentences.zh: 当被问及他希望布兰迪受到什么刑罚时，杰森回答说：

sentences.en: All I want and have ever wanted was to have her out of sight and mind so that I may move forward from this horror.
sentences.zh: 我所有的愿望、一直以来的愿望，就是让她从我的视线和脑海中消失，这样我才能从这场恐怖中走出来。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: After sitting quietly for four minutes, the presiding judge sentenced Brandy Warley to a total of 120 years in prison for the murders of Tyler and Charlie.
sentences.zh: 主审法官静静地坐了四分钟后，因谋杀泰勒和查理判处布兰迪·沃利总计120年监禁。

sentences.en: Brandy remained silent upon hearing the outcome.
sentences.zh: 布兰迪听完判决结果后保持沉默。

sentences.en: She was twice asked if she had anything to say, but she opted not to make a statement.
sentences.zh: 她曾两次被问及是否有话要说，但她选择不发表声明。

sentences.en: The judge acknowledged that people wanted an explanation as to how a loving mother could kill her own children, but told the court.
sentences.zh: 法官承认人们想要一个解释，弄清楚为什么一个慈爱的母亲会杀死自己的亲生孩子，但他对法庭表示：

sentences.en: Sometimes there is no explanation.
sentences.zh: 有时根本没有解释。

sentences.en: Darkness is in this world, and it penetrates minds and our hearts.
sentences.zh: 黑暗存在于这个世界中，它侵入我们的心灵。

sentences.en: In the week after Tyler and Charlie Worley were murdered, a post was made on the subreddit dedicated to American news commenter and YouTube personality Philip DeFranco.
sentences.zh: 在泰勒和查理·沃利被谋杀后的一周内，美国新闻评论员兼YouTube红人菲利普·德弗朗哥的专属Subreddit上出现了一篇帖子。

sentences.en: Titled, A Message for Phil, the author was a Redditor going by the username JasonInHell.
sentences.zh: 题为《给菲尔的一封信》，作者是一个网名为JasonInHell的Redditor用户。

sentences.en: He wrote,
sentences.zh: 他写道：

sentences.en: My name is Jason Worley.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是杰森·沃利。

sentences.en: I have watched Phil for several years now and his words have always brought me comfort in times of great loss.
sentences.zh: 我已经看菲尔的视频好几年了，在遭受巨大损失的时候，他的话总是能给我带来安慰。

sentences.en: Last Thursday, I lost my children, Tyler, age 7, and Charlie, age 3, in horrific tragedy.
sentences.zh: 上周四，我在一场可怕的悲剧中失去了我的孩子们，7岁的泰勒和3岁的查理。

sentences.en: Jason didn't elaborate any further and instead went on to write of his children's love of Phil's work.
sentences.zh: 杰森没有做更多详细说明，而是转而写起了他的孩子们对菲尔作品的喜爱。

sentences.en: Any kind words you can offer would be greatly appreciated,
sentences.zh: 您能提供的任何暖心话语都将不胜感激，

sentences.en: Jason requested, before encouraging Phil to hold his own baby son close.
sentences.zh: 杰森请求道，并鼓励菲尔紧紧抱住他自己的小儿子。

sentences.en: The post flew under Philip DeFranco's radar, but his audience took notice and looked into
sentences.zh: 这篇帖子没有引起菲利普·德弗朗哥的注意，但他的观众注意到了，并查看了

sentences.en: Jason's Reddit profile, where they came across his previous posts seeking advice about his cheating wife.
sentences.zh: 杰森的Reddit个人资料，在那里他们偶然发现了他的旧帖子，里面寻求关于他出轨妻子的建议。

sentences.en: Jason initially said he was staying with his wife for the sake of his children, but users unanimously told him to divorce her.
sentences.zh: 杰森最初说他是为了孩子才留在妻子身边的，但网友们一致劝他离婚。

sentences.en: He expressed gratitude for the advice, which he intended to follow.
sentences.zh: 他对这些建议表示感谢，并打算照办。

sentences.en: In searching Jason Worley, DeFranco's audience came across the outcome of that advice and informed the YouTuber, who filmed a video offering his support.
sentences.zh: 在搜索杰森·沃利时，德弗朗哥的观众偶然发现了该建议的结果，并通知了这位YouTube博主，后者拍摄了一段视频表达他的支持。

sentences.en: In the ensuing publicity, the Jason in Hell Reddit profile was deleted.
sentences.zh: 在随之而来的公开报道中，“地狱里的杰森”这个Reddit个人资料被删除了。

sentences.en: One day, a post appeared on the Relationship Advice subreddit by a user going by the name
sentences.zh: 有一天，“情感求助”板块上出现了一篇帖子，发帖人自称为

sentences.en: Jason in Code.
sentences.zh: 代码中的杰森。

sentences.en: Titled, An Update from Jason in Hell, it was Jason Worley, who explained
sentences.zh: 题为《来自地狱的杰森的最新进展》，发帖人正是杰森·沃利，他解释道

sentences.en: I deleted the Jason in Hell account in a knee-jerk reaction to seeing my Reddit posts in the news.
sentences.zh: 我在新闻中看到自己的Reddit帖子后，出于膝跳反应删除了“地狱里的杰森”账号。

sentences.en: I guess the first question to answer is how am I doing, and to that I would say I am doing well.
sentences.zh: 我想首先要回答的问题是我过得怎么样，对此我想说我过得很好。

sentences.en: He went on to describe the defeating bad days in which he had used alcohol to avoid nightmares of his children's final moments.
sentences.zh: 接着他描述了那些充满挫败感的糟糕日子，当时他曾借助酒精来逃避关于孩子们最后时刻的噩梦。

sentences.en: The support given by friends and family had been fundamental, enabling Jason to drop the habit before it caused too much damage.
sentences.zh: 朋友和家人给予的支持至关重要，使杰森在恶习造成太大损害之前将其戒掉。

sentences.en: He had also received treatment in hospital for suicidal thoughts that emerged following his children's murders.
sentences.zh: 他还因在孩子们遇害后产生的自杀倾向而在医院接受了治疗。

sentences.en: Jason wrote,
sentences.zh: 杰森写道：

sentences.en: From that, I learned that you should never be ashamed of your mental health, and not seeking treatment will only make it worse, not better.
sentences.zh: 从中我懂得了，你永远不该对自己的心理健康感到羞耻，不寻求治疗只会让情况变得更糟，而不是更好。

sentences.en: It hadn't been easy.
sentences.zh: 这并不容易。

sentences.en: Jason hadn't sought help initially, which led to him losing his job and becoming a recluse.
sentences.zh: 杰森最初并没有寻求帮助，这导致他失去了工作并变得离群索居。

sentences.en: He assured readers not to worry.
sentences.zh: 他向读者保证不用担心。

sentences.en: He had since returned to work and had nearly regained his former position and salary.
sentences.zh: 他此后已经重返工作岗位，并且几乎恢复了以前的职位和薪水。

sentences.en: However, his in-laws were an ongoing problem.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的岳父母仍然是一个持续存在的问题。

sentences.en: They owned the house that Jason and Brandy lived in and had changed the locks shortly after the murders, with Jason's belongings still inside.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有杰森和布兰迪住的那栋房子，并在谋杀案发生后不久就换了锁，当时杰森的私人物品还在里面。

sentences.en: He tried to negotiate the return of his property, but was accused of theft and told he had to pay to retrieve his belongings.
sentences.zh: 他试图通过协商取回自己的财物，却被指控盗窃，并被告知必须付费才能拿回物品。

sentences.en: Jason had to get law enforcement involved, but Brandy's family continued to make his life difficult.
sentences.zh: 杰森不得不让执法部门介入，但布兰迪的家人依然让他的生活举步维艰。

sentences.en: When Jason visited his children's grave on the one-year anniversary of their murders, his ex-wife's family sat in their truck and watched him the whole time.
sentences.zh: 当杰森在孩子遇害一周年之际去探望他们的坟墓时，他前妻的家人坐在卡车里一直盯着他。

sentences.en: Jason wrote,
sentences.zh: 杰森写道：

sentences.en: Because of that, I don't visit the grave as often as I would like to.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我去墓地的频率不如我想要的那般频繁。

sentences.en: In regards to how he felt about Brandy's sentencing, Jason explained
sentences.zh: 关于他对布兰迪判决的感受，杰森解释说

sentences.en: That is harder to answer because no matter what the sentence, nothing will bring back my beloved children.
sentences.zh: 这很难回答，因为无论判决如何，没有什么能让我的挚爱孩子们死而复生。

sentences.en: Do I think she should have gotten the death penalty, which Indiana has?
sentences.zh: 我是否认为她应该被判处印第安纳州拥有的死刑？

sentences.en: No, I do not.
sentences.zh: 不，我不这么认为。

sentences.en: She wanted to die, and after nine years of giving her what she wanted when she wanted it, I was not going to give her another thing.
sentences.zh: 她想死，而在九年里对她予取予求之后，我绝不会再给她任何她想要的东西。

sentences.en: Do I think the life sentence will have any appreciable effect on her?
sentences.zh: 我是否认为终身监禁会对她产生任何显著的影响？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: One thing she always stressed for the entire time that I knew her was that she lived her life without any regrets.
sentences.zh: 在我认识她的整个期间，她一直强调的一点是，她的人生没有任何遗憾。

sentences.en: Even after I caught her cheating on me, she continued to say she had no regrets.
sentences.zh: 甚至在我抓到她出轨之后，她依然说她没有遗憾。

sentences.en: Jason in Hell's Reddit history has been archived on RelationshipAdvice, where it remains locked in time.
sentences.zh: Reddit 上“地狱里的杰森”的相关历史已被归档到 RelationshipAdvice 板块，永远定格在了那个时间。

sentences.en: The posts and original comment threads can be viewed, but nothing else can be changed or added.
sentences.zh: 用户可以查看这些帖子和最初的评论串，但无法再做任何更改或添加内容。

sentences.en: The subreddit has since reflected on the lessons learned through Jason Worley's ordeal.
sentences.zh: 该子版块此后一直在反思从杰森·沃利的遭遇中吸取的教训。

sentences.en: Users who seek out his original posts are greeted with a message explaining that those who contributed to discussions at the time
sentences.zh: 寻找他最初帖子的用户会看到一条消息，解释说当时参与讨论的人

sentences.en: failed to consider the reality of the situation as best as they could have known.
sentences.zh: 未能尽其所能地考虑当时的实际情况。

sentences.en: Hindsight is 20-20 and encourages users to
sentences.zh: 事后诸葛亮总是明智的，这鼓励用户

sentences.en: realise the potential for complications which might make any advice difficult to follow.
sentences.zh: 意识到可能会使任何建议都难以遵循的复杂情况。

sentences.en: It ends with the remark
sentences.zh: 结尾写道

sentences.en: Something which seems obvious to any one of us is rarely ever obvious to someone in the weeds of the relationship itself.
sentences.zh: 对我们任何人来说显而易见的事情，对于深陷这段关系中的人来说却很少是显而易见的。

sentences.en: Redditors have rallied behind Jason in the aftermath of the murders, with his update post filled with comments expressing support and sympathy.
sentences.zh: 在谋杀案发生后，Reddit 用户纷纷声援杰森，他的更新帖子里充满了表达支持和同情的评论。

sentences.en: Despite his loss, Jason expressed gratitude to the relationship advice community and the service they provide to those in need, adding
sentences.zh: 尽管遭受了损失，杰森仍对情感建议社区及其为需要帮助的人提供的服务表示感谢，并补充说

sentences.en: There is one thing in particular that continues to haunt Jason.
sentences.zh: 有一件事尤其一直在折磨着杰森。

sentences.en: On the night of the murders, Brandy suggested that he sleep in the living room.
sentences.zh: 在谋杀案发生当晚，布兰迪建议他睡在客厅。

sentences.en: In an online post, Jason lamented,
sentences.zh: 杰森在一篇网帖中感叹道：

sentences.en: I just can't help but wonder that if I had slept on the couch like she had suggested, instead of an air mattress in the basement, then maybe I could have saved my children,
sentences.zh: 我就是忍不住去想，如果当初我听了她的建议睡在沙发上，而不是睡在地下室的气垫床上，那么也许我就能救我的孩子们，

sentences.en: or at the very least, died with them.
sentences.zh: 或者至少，能和他们死在一起。

sentences.en: A father has one job in this world, to protect his children.
sentences.zh: 一个父亲在这个世界上只有一项任务，那就是保护他的孩子。

sentences.en: And I failed to do that.
sentences.zh: 而我没能做到这一点。

sentences.en: In his final Reddit post to relationship advice, Jason Worley wrote,
sentences.zh: 杰森·沃利在发给情感建议板块的最后一篇 Reddit 帖子中写道：

sentences.en: If I can impart on you something I have learned through all of this, it is that you should always take the time to be with the ones you love.
sentences.zh: 如果我能向你们传授我通过这一切所学到的一点，那就是你一定要花时间陪伴你爱的人。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter if they are asking you to read The Pokey Little Puppy for the millionth time,
sentences.zh: 不管他们是让你第无数次读《慢吞吞的小狗》，

sentences.en: or asking you to play Smash Brothers, even though you both know they will wipe the floor with you every time.
sentences.zh: 还是让你陪他们玩《任天堂明星大乱斗》，尽管你们俩都知道他们每次都会把你打得落花流水。

sentences.en: Just do it, because you never know what time will be the last time.
sentences.zh: 做吧，因为你永远不知道哪一次会是最后一次。

sentences.en: Always make sure they know how much you love them.
sentences.zh: 一定要让他们知道你有多爱他们。

sentences.en: I had the fortune that the last thing my children ever heard me say was,
sentences.zh: 我很庆幸，我的孩子们听我对他们说的最后一句话是：

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: 我爱你。

sentences.en: Good night.
sentences.zh: 晚安。

sentences.en: I will see you in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我们早上见。
